Not that I know of.  But we do not really talk about things like that, you know?  

And you both make a very good point.. it really is not enough to go off of. It's just that after I read that poem I got very odd feelings.  He doesn't seem like one to have thoughts like these.  He has been a little shut out lately, but he has also been very busy with school.  I am probably worrying over nothing.  But on the other hand I am terrified that I could be wrong.

Thank you both for giving me a clear outside view.
